root_causes.title: Fence stripping (RFC-029 D3 regression)
root_causes.description: ALL content inside fenced code blocks is discarded. Docling wraps substantial Arabic content in ``` markers for the MOU document. The fence-stripping loop at lines 2724-2726 skips every line while in_fence=True, silently dropping the entire block rather than preserving content and stripping delimiters only.
root_causes.mechanism:
1. Docling exports markdown with fenced blocks wrapping Arabic/mixed-language sections (code-extraction hints)
2. RFC-029 D3 added fence stripping to remove rendering noise
3. Implementation toggles in_fence flag and skips ALL enclosed lines (not just delimiters)
4. Result: 13,564 chars → 1,487 chars (preamble only survives)
root_causes.evidence: Node count fell from 166→20, chars 13,564→1,487; both metrics point to content deletion not extraction change

root_causes.title: Garble gate misfire (consequence of primary)
root_causes.description: After fence stripping removes 89% of content, the remaining preamble has concentrated mixed-script English/Arabic text. This dense pattern triggers _has_sparse_mojibake() which reports ratio=1.00 with 0 actual garbled sequences. NOT a gate bug—consequence of reduced text density.
root_causes.mechanism:
Run 12: 13,564 chars → mixed patterns diluted → sparse mojibake below threshold
Run 13: 1,487 chars (preamble) → mixed patterns concentrated → triggers false positive on clean Arabic
root_causes.evidence: Garble gate reports ratio=1.00 but MOU body text is clean Arabic. The misfire only appears after fence stripping reduces content.

root_causes.title: Dead code: _check_bidi_coherence (RFC-029 D0 incompleteness)
root_causes.description: Function is defined TWICE (duplicate) but never called from any pipeline path. Designed to detect visual-order Arabic (reversed morphology) as a validate_tree gate. RFC-029 D0 implemented the function but never added the call site.
root_causes.mechanism:
1. Function exists and is logically correct (detects presentation-form glyph reversal)
2. RFC-029 D0 marked task 1.2 (implementation) complete
3. But wiring into validate_tree was never done
4. Duplicate definition suggests incomplete merge or abandoned implementation
root_causes.evidence: grep -r '_check_bidi_coherence' returns only the two definitions; zero call sites in src/
root_causes.relevance_to_mou: Would detect reversed Arabic in MOU body text if wired into gate

what_makes_mou_unique: Docling wraps Arabic content in fences (not just code/examples)
Preamble is only non-fenced section (unusual structure)
Majority of content in fenced blocks → all stripped
Mixed-language preamble creates concentrated sparse mojibake signals triggering false garble gate
verification_strategy:
1. Disable fence stripping (comment lines 2724-2726)
2. Re-run pipeline on MOU document
3. If chars recover to ~13,564: fence stripping is sole cause
4. If chars remain ~1,487: other RFC-029 changes (_repair_docling_tables, HR-separator stripping) also contributing
cluster_related_documents: سياسة حوكمة و إدارة البيانات - Copy.pdf - 23/24 reversed titles (bidi coherence dead code relevant)

fix_recommendations.title: Change fence stripping to preserve content (strip delimiters only)
fix_recommendations.rationale: Current implementation strips ``` delimiters AND all enclosed content. Design should extract content between delimiters, stripping only the ``` markers.
fix_recommendations.pseudocode:
if stripped.startswith('```'):
    in_fence = not in_fence
    i += 1  # skip the delimiter line itself
    continue
if in_fence:
    # Process line as content, don't skip
    # Pass to prose buffer or other handlers
    # (existing line-processing logic)
